description: Accept, decline or tentatively accept an invitation someone sent to this inbox; the organizer's calendar shows your answer. Pass the message_id of the invitation email (from list_invites) and response. Answer only when your operator asked you to.

credentials_dir.description: Credential directory for this call (default: ATOMIC_MAIL_CREDENTIALS_DIR or ~/.atomicmail). Use separate paths per account; see help topic multi_account.

name: respond_to_invite
title: Answer a meeting invitation
